------Applicant  VERSUS  State of Chhattisgarh through - Station House Officer, Police Station -  Dharamjaygarh, District - Raigarh Chhattisgarh  -------Non
-applicant
For Applicant : Mr. Sumit Shrivastava, Advocate
For State : Mr. Vinay Pandey, Dy. Adv. General
For Complainant/objector : Ms. Seema Mishra, Advocate  Hon'ble Shri Parth Prateem Sahu, Judge

ORDER ON BOARD  (15 / 07 /202 4)
1.

Applicant has filed this second bail application under Section 439 of CrPC for grant of regular bail as he has been arrested in connection with Crime No. 75/2024 registered at Police Station - Dharamjaigarh, District Raigarh (C.G.) for offence punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471,
120-B of IPC.
2.

Case of prosecution in brief is that on 24.02.2024 complainant/ maternal grandson of the deceased Kashi Ram (land owner) has lodged a report in the concerned police station stating that the land owned and recorded in the name of Kashi Ram has fraudulently been sold by some other person in favour of Chameli Sidar.
Based on the report, aforementioned crime was registered and applicant has been arrested on 29.02.2024.
3. Learned counsel for applicant submits that applicant is innocent has has been falsely implicated in the crime.

False allegation is levelled against applicant that he is working as land broker and he was also instrumental in selling land of deceased Kashi Ram by executing a sale deed through some Manmohan Rathiya vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 15 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/59787236/
1

sentences.text: other person impersonating him to be Kashi Ram.

Two of the co-accused Neutral Citation 2024:CGHC:25613 have been enlarged on anticipatory bail in MRCRA no. 234/2024 & MCRCA No.
335/2024 vide order dated 15.04.2024 & 24.04.2024 respectively.
Applicant is in jail since 29.02.2024, hence, he may be enlarged on bail.
4. Learned State counsel opposes the submission of learned counsel for applicant and submits that applicant is the main accused as the allegation against him is that he is working as land broker.

However, he does not dispute the submission of learned counsel for applicant that two co-accused persons have been enlarged on bail but submit that they are shown to be purchaser of the land recorded in the name of Kashi Ram.
5.
Ms. Seema Mishra, learned counsel for the complainant/ objector submits that she is having no objection if this court enlarges the applicant on bail.
6. I have heard learned counsel for the parties.

7. Taking into consideration the facts and circumstances of the case, nature of allegation,
submission of learned counsel for the respective parties, in particular the submission of learned counsel for the complainant and further that investigation is complete, charge-sheet has already been filed, period of detention, without commenting anything on merit of the case, I am inclined to enlarge the applicant on bail.
8. Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant shall be released on regular bail, upon furnishing a bail bond in the sum of   25,000/- with one surety in the like sum to the satisfaction of the Court on the conditions that- a) Applicant shall appear before the Trial Court regularly on each and every date,
unless exempted from appearance.
b) The applicant shall not, in any manner, tamper with the prosecution witnesses.
c) If the applicant is found involved in similar offence in future, it will be open for the State to apply for cancellation of Bail.
Certified copy as per rules.
